newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France Europe pilots extend strike by two days.
newsitem.headline: Air France Europe pilots extend strike by two days.

text.p: Three unions representing pilots and flight engineers at Air France Europe said on Tuesday they have extended a 12-day strike by 48 hours to cover Wednesday and Thursday.
The cabin crew unions also sent a telex message to Transport Minister Bernard Pons, saying management had not made any proposals for negotiations since the strike began on April 25.
The unions are protesting at Air France Europe's merger plans with parent international airline Air France, which they say will hurt their pay and conditions.

Air France chairman Christian Blanc is preparing a merger of the two airlines to prepare them for privatisation and to boost competitiveness. Blanc wants to put Air France Europe crews on the same pay scale as Air France counterparts, cutting salaries by around 15 percent.
